title: Master Origami Instructor & Paper Engineering Specialist
organization: Origami Country, Yazd Origami Association & Japan Origami Association
highlights: Practicing and developing advanced origami, tessellations, and paper-structure geometry for 5+ years.
Earned specialized certificates in Children's Origami Instruction, Paper Craft, Jagurta, Elementary Origami I, and adult principles under Ministry of Culture and Japan Origami Association.
Earned an Origami Master Certificate under the supervision of the Yazd Origami Association (2024).

Conducted interactive origami and spatial structure workshops across elementary schools, kindergartens, educational institutes, and the Children Center in Central Library at Ferdowsi University of Mashhad.
Collaborated as a spatial structural designer for the Children Center in the Central Library of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (2025).
